answer: Proof of burn mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to destroy native cryptocurrency at an unspendable address to mint an identity. An agent trading velvet must present this burn receipt, imposing non-refundable capital costs on an attacker per fake identity. This barrier protects pearl auctions and yarrow logistics from cheap identity floods. A key limitation is that proof of burn favors wealthy adversaries who can afford large burns while excluding undercapitalized honest agents.
